title: freeze on queue_free when using scrollbar
body:
### Tested versions

Produced in Godot v4.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) HD Graphics 520 (Intel Corporation; 30.0.101.1338) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6300U CPU @ 2.40GHz (4 Threads)

### Issue description

As the title says, Godot is freezing on queue_free, but not all the time. Bellow is the minimal project that causes this issue. When I run this project, the first and the second time I select a card and click "play", it works fine. But the third time it freezes. I've tried adding a small timer in board_manager.gd:28 (before the queue_free), it still froze, but after a couple of seconds it went back to normal, and stayed normal. When I was messing around with timer and call_deferred, it even messed up the x position of some cards which is really weird. That's why I suppose it's a bug in the engine. I've also attached a demo video of what I'm facing.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/25d275df-d8b3-4cad-9865-3eb9f0fd50e8

**Important Note**: If you lower the number of cards so the scrollbar disappears, the issue is not reproducible. You can test it from the inspector (Board node). That's why I had to mention it in the title. I attached a demo video of it as well. If you change the numbers, the amount of time you have to play before freezing may change as well.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2a535b9d-3b93-4aa7-8d01-c3c43a3bf073

I would also appreciate it if you know any workaround for this bug until it's fixed. thanks in advance

### Steps to reproduce

Just open and run.

[github-issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19049098/github-issue.zip)
